stories.headline: Stripe is buying OpenRouter for $7B to become the Stripe of AI
stories.blurb: Stripe is acquiring OpenRouter, a startup that routes API calls to different AI models and handles billing, for over $7 billion. OpenRouter's CEO had described it as 'Stripe for AI' — now it actually will be Stripe, letting developers switch between models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and others with one integration.
stories.why_it_matters: Payment infrastructure companies are now buying AI infrastructure companies at unicorn-exit scale.
stories.original_headline: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+

stories.headline: Anthropic hit $65B in annualized revenue, up $18B in two months
stories.blurb: The Claude maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months, reaching $65 billion total. That's faster growth than OpenAI saw during its ChatGPT surge, driven largely by enterprise adoption and API usage across Fortune 500 companies.
stories.why_it_matters: The fastest revenue acceleration in AI history suggests enterprise budgets have moved from pilot to production.

stories.headline: Cursor can now host your code in the cloud
stories.blurb: Cursor just launched Origin, its own code hosting service. You can now store repositories directly in Cursor instead of syncing through GitHub or GitLab. The feature is in early access and positions Cursor as more than an editor — it's becoming a full development platform.
stories.why_it_matters: Cursor is moving from AI-powered editor to end-to-end platform, competing directly with GitHub.

stories.headline: Reporters tracked rare books to an Amazon facility that scans and destroys them for AI
stories.blurb: 404 Media planted a tracking device in a shipment of rare books being sold in bulk. It ended at an Amazon facility where the company scans physical books to train AI models, then destroys them. The investigation reveals how tech companies source training data from the used book market.
stories.why_it_matters: AI companies are quietly buying up physical books at scale to build datasets most people never see.
stories.original_headline: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility

stories.headline: Nvidia is backing a $500 billion data center in Ohio for OpenAI
stories.blurb: Nvidia will invest up to $105 billion in what could become the world's largest data center, which OpenAI will lease to train future AI models. The facility's total cost could reach $500 billion, signaling the scale of infrastructure needed for next-generation AI.
stories.why_it_matters: The chip maker is now financing the compute infrastructure its biggest customer needs to keep scaling.
stories.original_headline: Nvidia to Back Ohio Data Center With as Much as $105 Billion

stories.headline: ChatGPT's Mac app now watches everything you do on your computer
stories.blurb: A new feature called Computer History records your clicks, keystrokes, and half-finished tasks to build a timeline ChatGPT can reference. It suggests automations based on how you work and can pick up where you left off. Your activity becomes training data the AI uses to understand your workflow.
stories.why_it_matters: ChatGPT is moving from chat window to always-on assistant that learns from watching you work.
stories.original_headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes

try_this_prompt.title: The hiring red flag finder
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'm interviewing someone tomorrow. I'll paste the role description and their resume below. Don't tell me if they're qualified — I can read. Instead, give me the three questions that will reveal whether they'll actually thrive here, and the one answer pattern that should make me pause.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: The night before an interview when your questions still feel too safe.
